The slides are written in English to accompany the Mandarin lectures. Each deck is a reveal.js page — open it in a browser, nothing to install.

Speaker notes are in Chinese, and they are not private: press `S`, or add `?showNotes=true` to the URL, and anyone can read them.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Keyboard shortcuts
`S` presenter view (with the Chinese speaker notes) · `B` chalkboard layer for writing on a slide · `ESC` slide overview · `F` full screen · add `?print-pdf` to the URL to print
:::
